description: road_traffic_counts_station_reference is a dataset listed in Peclet Data Portal open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Transport NSW. Traffic Collection Station Reference - This table provides a general description of the traffic collection station e.g. Geospatial coordinates, road name, suburb, postcode, device type, road number, road type including the data quality rating. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under Transportation, Movements, Parking, Mobility. The portal shows 1,783 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-peclet-com-au-portal.
